regionalRanges.label: Dallasaurus middle Turonian occurrence
regionalRanges.basis: The stage envelope captures the middle Turonian Dallasaurus skeletons without treating them as a globally complete family range.

overview: A node-defined family within broader Mosasauroidea; the package makes that clade boundary explicit and does not equate family membership with one fixed degree of paddle specialization.

ecology.locomotion: Axial swimming with lineage-dependent limb specialization

traits: Limb specialization varies among early and derived members
evidenceSummary: Explicit phylogenetic definitions and the Dallasaurus skeletons separate nomenclatural boundaries from locomotor character evolution; basal relationships remain analysis-sensitive.
